::: {.fragment .fade-in}
<div class="centered-text">It's All About Prediction!</div>
:::

:::{.notes}
- My work is focused on music... However, keep in mind...
- We are increasingly driven by algorithms in all aspects of life
- The terminology and diversity of techniques can make your head spin
- From linear regression through to the transformers that drive ChatGPT I would argue there is a common link: It's all about prediction!
- What is prediction?
- As we focus in on specific algorithms, I want to encourage folks to keep this larger context in mind
:::

## Many Users Are Unaware of Issues
<img src="img/take_awareness.png" class="top-right-image">

:::{.incremental}
- Drawing attention to long standing issues
- Older tools remain popular among music researchers
- "What do you mean it doesn't work perfectly?"
:::

::: {.bottom-left-box-2 .fragment}
Robustness studies help raise awareness
:::

## Always Be Testing!
<img src="img/take_evaluation.png" class="top-right-image">

:::{.incremental}
- Tools are constantly changing
- Developers can only test on limited datasets
- Let's build a strong, inter-disciplinary culture of evaluation!
- New approaches are valuable
  - and **NEEDED**
:::

::: {.bottom-left-box-2 .fragment}
Instability Audits afford accessible testing.
:::

## Improving The Techniques We Have
<img src="img/take_expanding.png" class="top-right-image">

:::{.incremental}
- More realistic generated audio is within reach!
- Interactions of transformations
- How robust do features need to be?
- More features! [More transformations!]{.fragment} [More MIDI files!]{.fragment}
:::

::: {.bottom-left-box-3 .fragment}
Instability Audits have so much potential!
:::

::: {.bottom-left-box .fragment}
**REPORT NOTE:** Mechanistic vs. Black Box
:::

:::{.notes}
- We used simple soundfonts to keep it open source
- technologies like VST could make really high quality audio, not to mention running evaluations in LIVELab

- We've looked at single transformations: what about interactions?
- I have some ideas about using monte-carlo style simulations...
:::

## No Tool Is Universal
<img src="img/take_universal.png" class="top-right-image">

:::{.incremental}
- Different music requires different solutions
- Tradeoffs: *"There ain't no such thing as a free lunch"*
- Users should consider creating tests for their use case
:::

::: {.bottom-left-box-2 .fragment}
IA only requires an understanding of musical properties.
:::

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const buzzwords = document.querySelectorAll('#buzzwords .buzzword');
  buzzwords.forEach((buzzword, index) => {
    // Set a longer initial delay based on the index
    const delay = (index + 1) * 1000; // 1 second for the first word, 2 seconds for the second, etc.
    setTimeout(() => {
      // Make each buzzword visible
      buzzword.classList.add('visible');
    }, delay);
  });
});
